🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 14, 2026

Sun, in Scorpio, holds a sextile to Moon, in detriment in Capricorn. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 3-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. From Capricorn, Moon cuts across the appetite. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. Across from you in Scorpio, Sun holds the other half of the account. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Venus in Libra trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Capricorn, the sign that suits it least. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Water that starts things, started cheaply. The conjunction of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. Venus in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Sun has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Capricorn sides with you before you have argued. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Forward again for a week now, Mercury has left the old ground.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Capricorn, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Air moves first and pays first. A week ago Venus was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Moon sextiles you from Capricorn: an opening to be reached for. Fixed water keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Libra, Venus makes something possible and nothing certain. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun in Scorpio opens a gap you have to step into. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. Three weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Sun squares you from Scorpio: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Air that holds on, charged for holding. The hold Moon had three weeks ago is not there any more.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.
